findings.title: Pod's ResourceClaimTemplate does not exist
findings.cause: the pod's resourceClaims entry gpu names ResourceClaimTemplate single-gpu, which does not exist in namespace kd-dra-claim-template-missing: no claim is made for the pod, and the scheduler waits for one; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: pod claims gpu through ResourceClaimTemplate single-gpu

evidence.detail: PodResourceClaim gpu: resource claim template "single-gpu": resourceclaimtemplate.resource.k8s.io "single-gpu" not found

evidence.what: there is no ResourceClaimTemplate single-gpu in namespace kd-dra-claim-template-missing

findings.fix: Create ResourceClaimTemplate single-gpu in namespace kd-dra-claim-template-missing (a template lives in the namespace of the pods that use it), or correct the name in the pod template.
